title: Ranges and NOT in sale_items · part 10

steps.title: Keep unit_price from 1486.38 to 3356.82
steps.prompt:
BETWEEN lo AND hi keeps a range (both ends included).
It is a tidy way to write two comparisons at once.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price BETWEEN 1486.38 AND 3356.82;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Write the two ends with AND between them.
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price BETWEEN 1486.38 AND 3356.82;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price BETWEEN 1486.38 AND 3356.82;
steps.memory_trick: BETWEEN a AND b = a <= x <= b.

steps.title: Keep unit_price outside 1486.38..3356.82
steps.prompt: NOT flips a test: NOT (something) means 'the opposite'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (unit_price BETWEEN 1486.38 AND 3356.82);
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Wrap the range in brackets after NOT.
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (unit_price BETWEEN 1486.38 AND 3356.82);
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (unit_price BETWEEN 1486.38 AND 3356.82);
steps.memory_trick: NOT reverses whatever is inside the brackets.
